about: The Curse of Alduin: lore, and the trials every city's Echo Altar sets before it wakes. (Noah, 2026-11-23: the trials remade to the story - the same four in every city, each with the city's own places) In order, all at night, shared by the party: restless (Lay the Restless to Rest: n of the risen slain in the altar's light, lightRadius, their souls rising past Alduin's mist), whisper (The Stone's Whisper - Felldir's Whisper once six altars are free: the altar speaks a riddle naming a place in the city (cities.whisper); find it at night and slay n of the risen there, within whisperRadius), echo (Hold the Light - Noah, 2026-11-24, in place of Repeat the Echo: at night, step into the altar's light and it closes in on the stone over the trial's seconds while the dead pour in; stand inside until it closes - outside, it slips back) and seals (Break the Priest's Seals: three dragon-script seals at city landmarks (cities.seals), each guarded by an elite; kill the guard, then strike the seal; the last calls the city's Dragon Priest out at once). Slaying the Dragon Priest frees the city and ends the night. Each trial's n is given per Skyrim difficulty, Novice to Legendary (iDifficulty 0-5). Progress lives in one global per city (5000000 + doneBits*100000 + active*10000 + progress, 9000000 = freed; a value from the old trials, under 5000000, starts the city fresh), saved with the game. Positions are x, y, z in the city's worldspace (the station's): the spot just outside each building's door, from Skyrim.esm. {city} is filled per city, {n} with the trial's count. A freed city is a sanctuary: no undead rise within zoneRadius of its station or in its own location.
prologue: Helgen burned, and you lived. Alduin did not stay to finish what he started: he flew north over the smoke, and as he went he shouted three words into the earth - SLEN TIID VO, Flesh, Time, Undo. It is the shout he uses to raise his dragons from their burial mounds, but this time it fell on every grave in Skyrim, and every barrow answered. His shout hangs like a mist over every road the dead walk - to Shor's hall and every other - and now the dead of Skyrim cannot pass: the mist turns them back, and when the sun goes down Alduin's voice throws them down to Skyrim again in beams of red light. The Dragon Priests who swore themselves to Alduin in the Merethic Era remember their oaths and wake with them. Only the Echo Altars the ancient Tongues raised in every hold can still his voice, and they have gone dark. Wake them, city by city, and their dead will sleep again.
liftedText: The altar of {city} rings with the old Tongues' answer, and Alduin's voice falls silent here. Its dead sleep again - none of the curse's dead will rise within its bounds.
freedAll: Every Echo Altar in Skyrim is awake. Alduin's voice lingers only in the wild places now - and in the echo he left on the Throat of the World.

whisper.riddle: Where the hammer wakes the anvil every morning and the river hears it ring, the valley's dead are gathering. Go to the smith's fire.
Below the Jarl's hall, where Arkay's priest lays the city's dead in beds of stone, the beds are empty. Go where Whiterun buries its own.
Where Solitude teaches its young to sing of the dead, the dead have come to listen. Go where the songs are learned.
There is a candle in this city that has burned since its first stone was laid, and never once gone out. The dead are drawn to it like moths. Find the hearth that never goes cold.
High in the city of stone, where Markarth kneels to beauty, beauty has turned grey and cold. Climb to the goddess's door.
Below the boardwalk, by the green water where thieves come and go unseen, the drowned are climbing out. Go down to the canal's iron door.
More dead than living lie in this town's earth, and tonight they are restless in their rows. Go where Falkreath counts its dead.
In a crooked hut at the marsh's edge, roots and mushrooms steep in the dark, and the drowned of the swamp come to drink. Find the brewer's door.
Where men cut a metal that runs like water out of the cold hill, the dead have dug their way up. Go to the mouth of the mine.
The rest of this town turns mages from its door. One fire still burns for them, and tonight the dead have found it. Go to the hearth that welcomes the College.

trials.title: Lay the Restless to Rest
trials.short: Slay the risen in the altar's light
trials.goal: Slay the risen in the light of the Echo Altar of {city}
trials.text: Alduin's mist bars the road to Sovngarde, and the dead of {city} have nowhere to go. Put them down within the light of the city's Echo Altar and their souls rise through the mist at last. Lay {n} of the risen to rest in the altar's light.

trials.title: The Stone's Whisper
trials.short: Find the place the altar's voice names
trials.goal: Find the place the altar's voice names in {city}, and slay the risen there
trials.text: At night a voice speaks from the Echo Altar of {city}, and it speaks in riddles. Find the place it names, and hold it against the dead: slay {n} of the risen there.

trials.title: Hold the Light
trials.short: Stand in the altar's light until it closes
trials.goal: Stand in the light of the Echo Altar of {city} as it closes round the stone
trials.text: When the Tongues first woke their altars, the light had to be held while Alduin's dead came for it. At night, step into the light of the Echo Altar of {city}: it begins to draw in toward the stone, and every one of the risen in the city comes for you. Stay inside the ring until it closes on the stone. Step out and the light falters and slips back.

trials.title: Break the Priest's Seals
trials.short: Shatter the Dragon Priest's three seals
trials.goal: Break the Dragon Priest's three seals in {city}
trials.text: The Dragon Priest who holds the altar of {city} silent has bound it with three seals of dragon script, set at the city's great places and each kept by one of his chosen. Kill each guard and strike its seal. When the last one breaks, the priest comes out to meet you.

Riverwood.name: Vahlok the Jailor
Riverwood.text: Vahlok kept the cult's prisoners in the Merethic Era, and his oath to Alduin was the last he swore. It has brought him out of his tomb and across the sea to the barrow above Riverwood, to keep the valley's altar dark.

Whiterun.name: Nahkriin, Warden of Skuldafn
Whiterun.text: Nahkriin guarded Skuldafn, the gate to Sovngarde, for Alduin, and the mist that bars Sovngarde's door is his to keep. He has come down from the mountains to the plains, so that Whiterun's dead never find the way home.

Solitude.name: Volsung of Volskygge
Solitude.text: Volsung ruled the peaks above Haafingar from Volskygge, and his mask let him breathe where no man could. He climbs down to Solitude now, and the dead of the Blue Palace's crypts rise at his word.

Windhelm.name: Zahkriisos the Frost-Priest
Windhelm.text: Zahkriisos lay in his tomb on Solstheim until Alduin's shout crossed the Sea of Ghosts. He walked over the ice to Windhelm's docks, and the cold he carries stops a heart.

Markarth.name: Otar the Mad
Markarth.text: Otar was so cruel that his own cult sealed him alive in Ragnvald. His oath to Alduin outlived his reason. He climbs out of the Reach's stone beneath Markarth to guard its altar.

Riften.name: Rahgot of Forelhost
Riften.text: Rahgot's followers poisoned themselves in Forelhost rather than surrender him to the Tongues. They rise with him now, and the Rift's dead follow them down to Riften's altar.

Falkreath.name: Krosis of Shearpoint
Falkreath.text: Krosis guarded the word at Shearpoint, mourning, for a thousand years. Alduin's shout gave him something to do with his sorrow: he comes down to Falkreath's graveyard to keep its children in the ground no longer.

Morthal.name: Hevnoraak of Valthume
Morthal.text: Hevnoraak's servants sealed him in Valthume to stop him rising. The seal could not hold against SLEN TIID VO: he walks out of the marsh fog, and Hjaalmarch's drowned dead follow him.

Dawnstar.name: Vokun of High Gate
Dawnstar.text: Vokun was a priest of shadows, and the Nightcaller's dreamers in Dawnstar dreamed his return a thousand years before it came. Kill him, and Dawnstar's nightmares end.

Winterhold.name: Morokei of Labyrinthian
Winterhold.text: Morokei once held the Staff of Magnus in Labyrinthian, and the College has feared him ever since. He has come to the cliffs above Winterhold, and the storm he calls has not finished yet.
